brand.name: Brasil Minis

patterns: Subtle carbon fiber weave (svg background) at 5% opacity.
Checkered flag accents on high-speed / performance categories.
Honeycomb mesh (like car grilles) for tech specs backgrounds.
Tire tread lines as subtle dividers.
Green/Yellow/Blue Brazil-inspired stripes (very subtle line, 2px max height) as header accent or bottom border.

visual_enhancers.animations: Smooth Framer Motion scroll, subtle hover lifts (-translate-y-1), and glow effects on active states.
visual_enhancers.borders: Rounded borders (rounded-xl, rounded-2xl), 1px solid #2E2E2E for cards.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Soft, diffuse shadows (shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)]) to separate dark layers.
visual_enhancers.icons: Outline icons (lucide-react) in white or primary blue.

layouts.hero: Full width image of premium dark garage with illuminated diecast cars. Overlay: bg-black/40. Left-aligned typography. H1 'Sua paixão em miniatura.', Subtitle 'As melhores marcas e edições exclusivas estão aqui.'
layouts.product_grid: High-density grid layout. Ample padding (p-6) inside cards. Dark cards (#1F1F1F) on darker bg (#111111).
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. py-24 for sections. gap-8 for grids.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure Exo 2 body text on #1F1F1F and #111111 meets APCA contrast standards. Use off-white (#E5E5E5) for body text rather than pure white to reduce eye strain.
accessibility.focus: Focus rings should use primary color #1E3A8A with offset.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly apply the exact colors: Primary #1E3A8A, Secondary #009B3A, Accent #FFC107. Neutrals: #111111 (Base BG), #1F1F1F (Cards), #2E2E2E (Borders/Hover).
Use ONLY .js files for React components. Do not generate .tsx files.
Install and configure Google Fonts for 'Orbitron' and 'Exo 2' in index.html.
Implement Shadcn UI using the dark theme strategy, adapting components to use #1F1F1F for surfaces, 1px #2E2E2E borders, and no pure white backgrounds anywhere.

Create a discreet glass effect for sticky navigation and modals (e.g., bg-[#1F1F1F]/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#2E2E2E]). DO NOT USE fully transparent backgrounds on elements that overlap content.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, inputs, and functional UI elements.
Apply subtle hover effects: framer-motion based small scaling (1.02) and button color transition.
The Hero Banner needs the title 'Sua paixão em miniatura.' and subtitle 'As melhores marcas e edições exclusivas estão aqui.'
Render specific Badges (NOVO, LANÇAMENTO, PROMOÇÃO, TREASURE HUNT, SUPER TH, PRÉ-VENDA, FRETE GRÁTIS) creatively using gradients or distinct brand colors on the product cards.
Implement the 'Trust Icons' section horizontally using Outline Icons (lucide-react).
Use Framer Motion for scroll entrance animations. Keep them smooth and not distracting.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Avoid 'AI slop'.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements only.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add '.App { text-align: center; }' in the css file.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped, or slightly rounded) with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
NEVER use placeholder URLs (via.placeholder.com). Use the curated images provided.
